title: Muse: a personal agent behind Privilege

glossary.definition: Whether a persona may call a tool at all. The first gate after detection.
The business rule inside an allowed call, such as a payment limit or an export row cap.

Two PingOne Authorize rules on the airline booking tool: yours (no tickets bought by an AI agent over your limit, $500 by default) and the airline's (only premium members over $750; the tier is the PingOne user attribute airlineMemberTier, read by Authorize). Mock simulates them; Real reads the gateway's answer. The Member tier card switches the tier between Premier Gold, Premier Silver and no tier: in Mock it sets the simulated member, in Real it writes the PingOne attribute on the demo users and reads it back.

muse.ai can book through the Airline Connector: list_flights shows the invented catalogue, book_flight sends only the flight id to the gateway. The two booking rules decide, and muse.ai is told booked, denied (which rule) or held for approval. Nothing is booked unless the gateway answered 200 with booked true. Authorize first checks that you let this agent act for you; the connector passes on the consent you gave at sign-in only when its owner has set up the consent bridge, otherwise the booking is denied for missing consent.
A detection flow in front of the gateway. It flags bursts of calls and instructions hidden in tool arguments. Simulated here.

cards.label: Trigger Muse-detect
cards.description: Send seven calls in a row and watch the seventh held.

cards.label: Staff cannot pay
cards.description: Sign in as staff and try a payment. The coarse check blocks it before any amount is checked.

cards.label: Two rules can stop a booking
cards.description: Book a flight as an AI agent or as Sam directly. Your rule stops agent tickets over your limit ($500); the airline's rule stops anyone but premium members over $750 (the tier comes from the PingOne user, a missing tier is not premium). Exactly $500 and $750 pass, and both rules are listed when both fail. Use the Member tier card to switch Premier Gold and Premier Silver and run the booking again.

cards.label: Book a flight from muse.ai
cards.description: In muse.ai, list the flights, book SH106 (an AI agent cannot buy over your limit), then SH101 (passes both rules, held for approval). Real mode, owner-run.

cards.label: Big payments need a person
cards.description: A payment over 500 is held until approved (simulated CIBA).
